Metadata.title: University Assignment Manager
Metadata.description: Semesters, subjects, assignments, calendar and CGPA in one study workspace.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.subtitle: Start by adding your current semester, then its subjects. Deadlines, progress and CGPA will appear here from your own records.
Dashboard.upcomingEmpty: No deadlines yet. Tasks you add with a due date will show up here.

semesters.title: Semesters
semesters.description: Group your subjects by semester and archive finished ones without losing anything.
semesters.emptyBody: Create a semester with its dates to start organising your subjects.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Each subject holds its lecturer details, tasks, files and links.
subjects.emptyBody: Add a semester first, then add the subjects you are taking.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Assignments, quizzes, projects and every other academic activity.
tasks.emptyBody: A task only needs a title and a subject. You can add the deadline, notes and files later.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Month, week and agenda views of your deadlines.
calendar.emptyBody: Tasks with a due date will appear on the calendar.

grades.title: Grades & CGPA
grades.description: Semester GPA and cumulative CGPA calculated from your grade records.
grades.emptyBody: Enter grades manually or import a transcript. Calculated results are not official university records.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Past semesters with all their subjects, tasks, files and grades.
archive.emptyBody: Semesters you archive will stay searchable here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Deadline reminders and sync or analysis problems.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: Changing the language never changes your tasks, deadlines, grades or documents. Your choice is saved to your account and used on every device.

Auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to open your study desk.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Your semesters, tasks and grades stay private to you.
signup.checkEmailBody: If this address can be registered, we sent a confirmation link to it. Open the link to finish signing up.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way.

Auth.notConfiguredBody: The Supabase project keys are missing. Follow docs/SETUP.md to add them to .env.local, then restart the server.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too easy to guess. Try a longer one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Sign-in is not connected yet. See docs/SETUP.md.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
